source.author: Lechpol (Cabletech / Kruger&Matz), mirrored by Gutek

simulator.note: As the M3602 family (chip ID 0x3602, 2026-10-10): its application starts ("Application version 1.0.0@SDK4.0ba.5.0_GLS_T_64M_20110510") but started over every ~38 M instructions -- its bootloader pulses bit 31 of the chip ID word (0xB6020000, 0x36020000, ...), which, kept, made the application read the chip as 0xB602 and its display driver's attach (0x8027CED8) reboot it.  With the chip ID word read-only (2026-10-13) it runs on: it asks the tuner at I2C 0x60 for its ID (MaxLinear register 0xD3 through the 0xFB prefix; 0x41 = MxL5007T, 0x801C20B8) and the M3101 demodulator at 0x20 (8-bit 0x40) for its registers -- with no chip answering there it waits at that point; with a register file at 0x20 the driver's init runs through (its I2C gateway, the tuner's set-up behind it, reset bit 3 of register 0x01) and then polls register 0x04 for lock.  About 85 M instructions in -- after a byte-by-byte scan of a flash area through its storage driver -- the application shows its boot logo: it writes the logo chunk (0x02FD0100, 0x4DA5 bytes) into the MPEG decoder's buffer twice, and the decoder (DECV_S3601_0) parses it, programs the video engine (0xB8004200: quantiser tables, buffer pointers, 45 x 36 macroblocks) and starts it (+0x14 = 0x200000F).  It then polls the decoder (io_control 5, 0x80002A9C) until the first picture has been shown -- bit 3 of the driver's state word (+0xE0C), which the frame-request callback it hands the video output driver (0x802B2A78) sets.  Neither the video engine's completion nor the video output's interrupts are modelled yet: no GE command after the 6 that clear its region.  A prototype (2026-10-13) got further.  The engine completing at once (status +0x18 bit 0, write-1-to-clear, interrupt-controller line 1; its VLD bit offset +0x228, counted from the buffer at 0x02000000 | (+0x224 & 0xFFFFFF), moved on to the next start code that is not a slice's within the +0x22C bits it was given) decodes both copies, and the driver's picture-done handler runs (a completion while its state lacks bit 1 sends the interrupt handler to the firmware's fatal handler, 0x800005B0).  The HD video output's interrupt (VPO_S3602F_HD, line 2: register 0xB8006004, enables in bits 0..5, status in bits 8..13, write-1-to-clear) then runs its handlers: bit 2 every frame calls the decoder's display callback, bits 4 / 5 the frame handler that requests frames (0x8025AAA8).  But once the decoder holds a picture the output's layer queue slot stays taken (0x802597D4: its entry's byte 9 is not 0xFF), the decoder's frame-release callback is never called and no frame is shown -- the next thing to find.

desc: Cabletech URZ0083 firmware V1.1.2, the manufacturer's USB update image as Gutek's site mirrors it (v112.rar); the archive also holds the update instructions (the box's menu: Narzędzia / Aktualizacja oprogramowania przez USB, the file chosen under "Allcode") and the change list.

Despite the .abs name it is a complete flash image: the ALi chunk chain from offset 0 -- bootloader 0x000000 (DVBT---0.1.0, 2010-06-01), HDCPKey 0x00FE00 (Demo s3602, 2009-11-10), maincode 0x010000 (Demo M3606, 2011-10-12), Radioback 0x160000 (1.0.0, 2009-05-08), countryband 0x170000 (1.0.0, 2010-4-1), userdb 0x18FF80 (1.0.0, 2011-10-12); the maincode's CRC-32/MPEG-2 is intact.  Banners in its LZMA streams: Libcore version 5.0.0@SDK4.0ba.5.0_20110425.
Gutek's list: "Cabletech URZ0083 (UWAGA SOFTY NIE DO URZ0083E)" -- not for the URZ0083E; the later URZ0083Q (dumps/CABLETECH URZ0083Q/) is an ALi M3801 board.

Change list (lista_zmian.txt, Polish): URZ0083_v1.1.2.abs / - Zwiększono czcionkę przy wyświetlaniu napisów z zewnętrznych nośników / URZ0083_v1.1.1.abs / - Poprawiono skalowanie obrazu przy odtwarzaniu materiałów z nośników zewnętrznych / - Zwiększono zakres wyboru rozdzielczości / J1100223_MC6238_URZ0083_v1.0.18 / - wydłużony czas projekcji informacji o czasie nagrywania / J1100223_URZ0083_v1.0.16 / - Poprawione skalowanie formatu obrazu (16/9,4/3) / - Dekodowanie dźwięku Dolby E-AC3 / - Dodano obsługę polskich napisów przy odtwarzaniu filmów z nośników zewnętrznych.

Gutek's review of the URZ0083 and URZ0086 (https://www.gutek.com.pl/tunery_cabletech_urz0083_urz0086_recenzja.htm): the URZ0083 is built on the ALi M3601E with an ALi M3100 demodulator and 64 MB DDR2, the URZ0086 on the ALi M3606 with 128 MB DDR2.  The simulator runs them as the M3602 family (chips/m3602.py).
